description: Simulated variational quantum circuit (torch statevector), PCA→angle encoding, ⟨Z⟩→linear→softplus; bounded subset only (research).
unit: expected S-NPP VIIRS type-0 detections per 5 km cell per UTC calendar month; AOI value = sum over the AOI's cells

feature_definitions.aqua_count: Aqua MODIS type-0 detections in the 5 km cell and UTC calendar month (transform log1p)
feature_definitions.aqua_frp_sum: sum of FRP (MW) of Aqua type-0 detections with finite frp (log1p)
feature_definitions.aqua_frp_mean: aqua_frp_sum / number of those detections; 0 if none (log1p)
feature_definitions.aqua_conf_mean: mean MODIS confidence (0-100) of Aqua type-0 detections; 0 if none (identity)
feature_definitions.aqua_scan_mean: mean scan (km) of Aqua type-0 detections; 0 if none (log1p)
feature_definitions.terra_count: Terra MODIS type-0 detections in the cell-month (log1p); separate series, never pooled into the target
feature_definitions.aqua_count_3x3: sum of aqua_count over the 3x3 block of cells (ix-1..ix+1, iy-1..iy+1) incl. itself; cells outside the universe add 0 (log1p)
feature_definitions.lat: latitude (deg) of the cell centre = degrees(asin((iy+0.5)*5000/6371007.181)) (identity)
feature_definitions.aqua_clim: mean aqua_count of this cell for this calendar month over the TRAIN years 2013-2020 (available months only) (log1p)
feature_definitions.country_AUS: 1 if the cell belongs to Australia (FIRMS country file) else 0 (identity)
feature_definitions.country_BGD: 1 if the cell belongs to Bangladesh (FIRMS country file) else 0 (identity)
feature_definitions.country_USA: 1 if the cell belongs to United_States (FIRMS country file) else 0 (identity)

spatial_holdout: 20% of 100 km blocks excluded from train

pennylane_crosscheck.reason: pennylane not importable: ModuleNotFoundError("No module named 'pennylane'")

intended_use: Retrospective harmonised fire-activity calendar (VIIRS S-NPP scale) for 2003–2012; comparison for 2012+.
limitations: FIRMS detections are not burned area; no cloud-cover denominator (coverage_fraction null); relationship may drift with land use; Terra kept separate.
